DevOps Engineer salary in Colorado

Based on 8 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 25, 2026), listed pay for DevOps Engineer jobs in Colorado is $110,937–$149,325 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $127,695 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $127,695 a year across 8 current postings. The middle 50% is $110,937–$149,325 a year.

Which employers list the highest pay?

KBR: about $142,150 a year (median of 2 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

Is this a salary survey?

No. The figures are listed pay in current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI, not a salary survey or a prediction of an offer. Listings without usable pay are excluded.
